description: Exploratory transcript and word-boundary disagreement screening; AMI reference timings are automatic and cross-speaker overlap makes matching ambiguous. No independently verified timing or caption-render accuracy is claimed.

environment.snapshotLimitation: Cache reference observed locally; backend model bytes were not independently authenticated.

windows.ffmpegVersion: ffmpeg version 9.0.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

timingScreening.limitation: Word matches and reference timestamps are automatic; omissions and ambiguous matches are not timing successes.

transcriptScreening.limitation: Reference timings are automatically aligned; cross-speaker overlap makes linear word order ambiguous.

warnings: Candidates require review and separate evidence-bound approval before any edit.
Visual context is unavailable; ranking uses speech evidence only.
No safe candidates were issued at some sentence boundaries because word confidence was low; review the transcript.
windows.referenceTiming: AMI word text is manually transcribed; word timestamps are automatically aligned and are not human-verified boundaries.
limitations: Reference overlaps are screening disagreements, not proof of speech clipping.
A provider declaration does not prove which model bytes were loaded.
No listening or native acceptance is implied.
